acceptance: Filter design report with OEM confirmation (Na+K at compressor inlet below OEM limit at 165 ug/m3 NaCl); Na+K air sampler downstream of the filters with 12 months of data reported during the Defects Notification Period
section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: The plant shall be designed for the airborne contaminants in ALP-OWN-MET-001 section 6: sea-salt aerosol up to 165 ug/m3 (as NaCl) during lodos storms, chloride deposition up to 420 mg/m2 per day, PM10 up to 260 ug/m3. The gas turbine inlet air filtration shall keep sodium plus potassium at the compressor inlet within the OEM limit for all these conditions, including high-humidity and fog (coalescer/droplet separator stage upstream of the fine filters, hydrophobic final filters of class E12 or better). Outdoor electrical equipment: creepage distance for very heavy pollution (IEC 60815, 31 mm/kV).
title: Airborne salt and dust
